description: Repeated native file activation closed the chooser without selecting a file. A later trial switched to selecting the row then Open and completed. Underlying desktop/browser cause remains unproven.

note: Retained observed badcase; a single trajectory does not establish an OS cause or stable failure rate.

review_notes.observation: Purchase orders are visible. The agent alternates tabs, opens many duplicate order tabs, and never types the amount or submits.
review_notes.candidate_explanation: Cross-page facts are absent from the next model request unless encoded in an action; memory limitation is a hypothesis for the observed loop.

diagnostic_recovery.note: Single diagnostic recovery with a model-authored notebook; not an OS-cause or stability claim.
